description: IIS NTLM EPA calibration profile for generic HTTP/HTTPS endpoints.

states.name: epa_off_expected_invalid_credentials
states.why: Synthetic credentials were rejected with a normal HTTP 401/403 style response and no EPA/CBT keywords.
limitations: This state does not prove EPA is disabled; it only separates ordinary credential rejection from EPA-specific signals.

states.name: epa_accept_or_indistinguishable_with_cbt
states.why: CBT input was available and synthetic credentials were rejected without an EPA-specific diagnostic.
limitations: IIS EPA Accept and disabled modes may be indistinguishable with random credentials unless paired with a no-CBT baseline.

states.name: epa_required_binding_signal
states.why: The HTTP authenticate response contains EPA/CBT-specific wording or classifier signals.
limitations: Promotion requires this wording to be stable across repeated lab captures for the same IIS build and endpoint.
